svg.title: At a glance
svg.desc: Eight axes: Four run nightly. Compress, heal, evolve and update keep their own clocks.; No win, no rewrite: Old and new prompt face a judge. Only a win ships the rewrite.; Claude Code and Codex: One installer wires both. Codex loads the MCP server, Claude Code not yet.; Local retrieval: Ollama embeddings in sqlite-vec plus SQLite FTS5, merged by reciprocal rank.; Obsidian is the memory: Inbox, notes, MOCs, skills, prompts, an index and an append-only log.; Nothing is deleted: Edits add a dated section; compress archives the original first.
